items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: Talbert. In Howard, they were the two trumpet players, George Lewis, Lawrence Marrero, Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: Talbert. In Howard, they were the two trumpet players, George Lewis, Lawrence Marrero, Jim Robinson.

I think I heard you the first time, it was across the river, along the west we go, along that road that goes up the river, with Ezreal Gorman one night, and Jim Robinson. I don't know, it wasn't anybody's special, organized band, it just happened to be a pickup band, but that's the first time I ever saw you and got to hear you. Then I didn't hear you for a few years, until you were here on Bourbon Street with George and all that. Yeah. I believe.
